<thought>We need to identify which candidate SMILES matches the observed 13C NMR shifts: 168.60, 143.85, 130.30, 22.80, 21.35, 19.20 ppm. I will simulate the 13C NMR for each candidate and compare the simulated shift lists to the observed values. The correct structure should show a carbonyl carbon near ~168 ppm, sp² carbons near 144‑130 ppm, and three aliphatic carbons around 22‑19 ppm. I will iterate through the candidates.</thought>

<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCON1C=CCN1"}</action_input>

<thought>Now simulate the next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C1CCNC1.C(=N)=O"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C=C(CNCO)N=C"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C1CC1OCC(=N)N"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CC(C)N(CC#N)O"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CN1CN(C=C1)OC"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C1C[C@@H]([C@H]1C(=O)N)N"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C1[C@H]([C@@H]1C(=O)N)CN"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "C1C(CN=C1N)CO"}</action_input>

<thought>Last candidate.</thought>
<action>simulate_spectra</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCC(=O)N1CNC1"}</action_input>
